06081.notes: California tax-deed county (no lien certificates). San Mateo sells tax-defaulted land at public internet auction. County materials and Bid4Assets historically hosted San Mateo sales (e.g. $1,500 deposit + $35 fee on older storefronts). A Grant Street MyTaxSale portal (sanmateo.mytaxsale.com) also exists with free year-round registration; as of mid-2026 the next sale was listed as not yet scheduled. Always confirm the current vendor and deposit on tax.smcgov.org / Bid4Assets / MyTaxSale before registering. Power to sell after 5 years of delinquency (standard CA rules).

06081.survivingLiens: A California tax deed conveys free of most liens existing before the sale, but federal tax liens survive (IRS 120-day post-sale redemption right), as do taxes/assessments that become payable after the sale.
06081.quietTitle: Not a statutory prerequisite, but practically required — most California title insurers will not insure tax-deed property without quiet title (commonly 3–6 months, $3,000–$8,000+), and many wait a year after deed recording.

06075.notes: City and County of San Francisco (consolidated) tax-deed process. Sold as-is; minimum bid typically taxes + costs. Excess proceeds claims available to parties of interest within one year of deed recording. No lien certificates.

48491.notes: Texas redeemable tax deed county. Williamson does not sell tax lien certificates. Delinquent-tax attorneys McCreary, Veselka, Bragg & Allen (MVBA) conduct judicial tax foreclosure sales under the Texas Property Tax Code. Sales only on the first Tuesday of a month when parcels are posted; lists, minimum bids, and rules appear on mvbalaw.com/tax-sales ~30 days prior. In-person at northeast side of Williamson County Justice Center Annex, 4th & Martin Luther King, Georgetown, 10:00 a.m. Post-sale redemption: typically 2 years homestead/ag/mineral, 180 days other property.

auctionPlatform.label: MVBA — Williamson County delinquent tax sales

48491.auctionFrequency: First Tuesday of the month when a sale is scheduled (not every month) — confirm on MVBA
48491.depositRules: Register with the person conducting the sale before bidding. Payment terms follow MVBA/Williamson sale rules — typically certified funds for winning bids (confirm current Information Sheet PDF). No Bid4Assets-style advance deposit for the standard in-person sale.
